source_title: New Danny Masterson loses appeal of rape conviction Griffin Jaeger News - Entertainment | 8 minutes ago
source_excerpt:
That '70s Show actor will continue serving his 30 year sentence
Danny Masterson's appeal of his 2023 rape convictions was denied on Tuesday, upholding his 30-year prison sentence.
In the 89-page ruling viewed by CBC News, a panel of three judges rejected all of the actor's arguments, including his claim that the judge in his trial was biased against Scientology.
The panel unanimously found that the 50-year-old did not demonstrate that the court made any errors that would warrant a new trial.
Masterson, known for his role on That '70s Show , was convicted in 2023 of two counts of rape against two women in 2003, which was a retrial after the first trial ended with a deadlocked jury in 2022. The jury in 2023 wasn't able to reach a verdict on a count involving a third person who alleges she was raped in 2001. He is currently serving 30 years to life in prison .
The actor is a member of the Church of Scientology. At the time, his accusers were members as well and said they had blamed the c hurch for their hesitancy in going to police about Masterson.
They testified at the time that when they reported him to Scientology officials they were told they were not raped, were put through ethics programs and were warned against going to law enforcement to report a member of such high standing.
Masterson stands with his lawyer Thomas Mesereau as he is arraigned on rape charges at Clara Shortridge Foltz Criminal Justice Center on Sept. 18, 2020, in Los Angeles. (Lucy Nicholson/Getty Images)
In the appeal, attorneys for Masterson argue that he was denied his First Amendment right of free exercise of religion and that a judge made several statements "lacking neutrality" and "with hostility" toward Scientology.
"Those statements, viewed in context, evidence no animus or departure from neutrality regarding Scientology," says the ruling by the panel of judges for the California Second District Court of Appeal.
"The jury in his case was not asked to determine the truth or falsity of Scientology doctrine or beliefs," the appeals court wrote, adding that "admission of Scientology evidence for those purposes did not contravene the First Amendment."

The panel also rejected arguments about the statute of limitations and evidentiary rulings. It also denied a separate habeas corpus petition arguing Masterson didn't get an adequate defence.
CBC News reached out to representatives for Masterson but did not hear back at the time of publication.
In a statement to CBC News, Masterson's appellate attorneys Cliff Gardner and Eric Multhaup said they will seek review with the California Supreme Court and also pursue a separate petition.
If you're in immediate danger or fear for your safety or that of others around you, please call 911. For support in your area, you can look for crisis lines and local services via the Ending Sexual Violence Association of Canada database . ​​
Griffin Jaeger is a reporter and producer with CBC's entertainment unit. He also formerly hosted and produced content for The National’s digital platforms. You can reach him at griffin.jaeger@cbc.ca

hi_body:
अभिनेता डैनी मास्टरसन को अपनी 30 साल से उम्रकैद की सजा काटते रहना होगा क्योंकि कैलिफोर्निया की एक अपीलीय अदालत ने मंगलवार को उनकी अपील को खारिज कर दिया, जिससे उनकी 2023 की बलात्कार दोषसिद्धि बरकरार रही है।

सीबीसी न्यूज द्वारा देखे गए 89 पन्नों के फैसले के अनुसार, तीन न्यायाधीशों की एक पीठ ने 50 वर्षीय 'दैट '70s शो' के अभिनेता द्वारा प्रस्तुत सभी तर्कों को सर्वसम्मति से खारिज कर दिया। अदालत ने पाया कि मास्टरसन यह प्रदर्शित करने में असफल रहे कि अदालत ने कोई ऐसी त्रुटि की हो जो नए मुकदमे को उचित ठहरा सके।

## फैसले और तर्कों का विवरण

* **मुकदमा और दोषसिद्धि:** मास्टरसन को 2003 की घटनाओं में दो महिलाओं के साथ बलात्कार के दो मामलों में 2023 में दोषी ठहराया गया था। 2023 का यह मुकदमा 2022 के उस मुकदमे के बाद हुआ था जो जूरी के बीच असहमति के कारण समाप्त हुआ था। जूरी 2001 के आरोपों से जुड़े तीसरे मामले पर किसी फैसले पर नहीं पहुंच पाई थी।
* **धार्मिक तर्क:** मास्टरसन के बचाव पक्ष के वकीलों ने तर्क दिया था कि धर्म की स्वतंत्रता के उनके प्रथम संशोधन अधिकारों का उल्लंघन किया गया है, और दावा किया कि मुकदमे के जज ने चर्च ऑफ साइंटोलॉजी के प्रति शत्रुता और तटस्थता की कमी दिखाई थी, जिससे मास्टरसन जुड़े हुए हैं।
* **अपीलीय निष्कर्ष:** न्यायाधीशों की पीठ ने कहा कि ट्रायल जज की टिप्पणियों ने, संदर्भ में देखे जाने पर, साइंटोलॉजी के प्रति कोई दुर्भावना या तटस्थता से प्रस्थान नहीं दिखाया। अदालत ने उल्लेख किया कि जूरी से साइंटोलॉजी के सिद्धांतों की सच्चाई का मूल्यांकन करने के लिए नहीं कहा गया था।
* **अतिरिक्त दावे:** अपीलीय पीठ ने परिसीमा अधिनियम (स्टेच्यूट ऑफ लिमिटेशन), साक्ष्य संबंधी फैसलों और नाकाफी बचाव का दावा करने वाली एक अलग बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण याचिका (हैबीस कॉर्पस) से जुड़े तर्कों को भी खारिज कर दिया।

## अगले चरण और कानूनी प्रतिनिधित्व

मास्टरसन के अपीलीय वकीलों, क्लिफ गार्डनर और एरिक मुलथॉप ने सीबीसी न्यूज को दिए एक बयान में कहा कि वे कैलिफोर्निया सुप्रीम कोर्ट में समीक्षा की मांग करेंगे और एक अलग याचिका पर भी आगे बढ़ेंगे। प्रकाशन के समय मास्टरसन के प्रतिनिधियों ने टिप्पणी के अनुरोधों का तुरंत जवाब नहीं दिया।

## व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन

मूल अदालत के फैसले को सत्यापित करने के इच्छुक पाठकों के लिए, कैलिफोर्निया सेकेंड डिस्ट्रिक्ट कोर्ट ऑफ अपील के सार्वजनिक रिकॉर्ड आधिकारिक राज्य अदालत के डेटाबेस के माध्यम से एक्सेस किए जा सकते हैं। यौन हिंसा से प्रभावित कोई भी व्यक्ति एंडिंग सेक्सुअल वायलेंस एसोसिएशन ऑफ कनाडा डेटाबेस जैसे संगठनों के माध्यम से स्थानीय सहायता संसाधन और संकट हेल्पलाइन पा सकता है।

en_body:
Actor Danny Masterson will continue serving his 30-year-to-life prison sentence after a California appellate court denied his appeal on Tuesday, upholding his 2023 rape convictions.

According to an 89-page ruling reviewed by CBC News, a three-judge panel unanimously rejected all arguments presented by the 50-year-old *That '70s Show* actor. The court found that Masterson failed to demonstrate any trial errors that would justify a new trial.

## Details of the Ruling and Arguments

* **Trial and Conviction:** Masterson was convicted in 2023 on two counts of rape involving two women in incidents dating back to 2003. The 2023 trial followed a 2022 retrial that ended in a deadlocked jury. A jury did not reach a verdict on a third count involving an allegation from 2001.
* **Religious Arguments:** Masterson's defense attorneys argued that his First Amendment rights regarding the free exercise of religion were violated, claiming the trial judge displayed hostility and a lack of neutrality toward the Church of Scientology, to which Masterson belongs.
* **Appellate Finding:** The panel of judges stated that the trial judge's remarks, when viewed in context, did not show animus or depart from neutrality. The court noted that the jury was not asked to evaluate the truth of Scientology doctrines and that admitting evidence related to the church did not violate constitutional rights.
* **Additional Claims:** The appellate panel also rejected arguments concerning the statute of limitations, evidentiary rulings, and a separate habeas corpus petition alleging inadequate defense.

## Next Steps and Legal Representation

Masterson's appellate attorneys, Cliff Gardner and Eric Multhaup, stated in a message to CBC News that they plan to seek a review with the California Supreme Court and pursue a separate petition. Representatives for Masterson did not immediately respond to requests for comment at the time of publication.

## Practical Implications and Verification

For readers seeking to verify the original court decision, public records from the California Second District Court of Appeal can be accessed through official state court databases. Anyone affected by sexual violence can find local support resources and crisis lines through organizations such as the Ending Sexual Violence Association of Canada database.
